title: Lava Chicken ft. Steve (A Minecraft Movie)
description: Steve's singing from A Minecraft Movie.
body:
!["Music Disc Revamps"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f0d22203c4e0c9eec57c59e3d7fc07e3774eb855.png)

## **Edited Music Disc(s):**
> ### _Lava Chicken_ by Hyper Potions
- Layers _Steve_'s singing from _A Minecraft Movie_ onto the disc.

## **Note**: 
> The pack should still work on version **1.21.7 & above** (the release of the Lava Chicken music disc).
- Download from the website then move the file to your resource pack folder.

## **Music Disc Revamps:**
> Music Disc Revamps is a small collection of resource packs (created by myself), that alter & revamp music discs. This can be the names, looks, or songs of 1(+) music disc.
